description:
One answer for a place: this week's forecast risk by day, hazard events nearby, the headline
climate exposures (heat, flood, sea-level rise, water stress, drought, heavy rain, fire, climate
zone) and the risk profile of the country it lies in. The best first call for a general
question about a location; get_climate_profile has every climate layer.

place.description: A place name or address, used when latitude and longitude are not given
